Package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.events

package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.events
Contains the event cards drawn from the tribe deck.

Event cards are resolved during board phases and apply effects to all players in the match rather than being drafted into a tribe like normal character cards.
